obligation: G002 by-product / directive 25, 32, 81 — the cross-specimen ORGAN PRIOR
statistic: within-tensor effective-rank deficit against a SAME-SHAPE random null, so the ordering is shape-corrected by construction
headline: THREE RELATIONS HOLD IN EVERY BODY THAT HAS BOTH ORGANS: gate_proj > up_proj 15/15, o_proj > up_proj 17/17, q_proj > up_proj 15/15. up_proj is the LEAST compressible organ in every dense body measured, and the attention Q/K/O organs are consistently more compressible than the MLP.
the_shape_control_is_built_in: the null is a random matrix OF THE SAME SHAPE, so a wide organ is compared against a wide null. gate_proj and up_proj are additionally IDENTICAL in shape in a SwiGLU MLP -- verified on real headers: Qwen3-14B [17408,5120] both, Qwen3-0.6B [3072,1024] both, Mistral-Small [32768,5120] both. So gate > up 15/15 is a FUNCTIONAL asymmetry between the two projections, not a geometric one.
what_it_licenses: organ-specific allocation with a measured ordering rather than a guess. q_proj never drops below a 26.04% deficit across 33 measurements while up_proj medians 9.46% and tops out at 23.53% -- so at a fixed global byte budget, structure-exploiting representations should be aimed at Q/K/O first and up_proj last.
honest_limits: deficit measures how much low-rank structure EXISTS, not that factoring it PAYS or that CAPABILITY survives -- on O003 the best cell still only saved 6.3% of bytes. And this is a DENSE-body prior; the MoE expert organs were measured separately and are a different question.
classification_per_directive_81: ARCHITECTURE-FAMILY PRIOR across dense transformers, not a universal Law: 22 bodies, 3 relations at 100%, the rest 85-95% with named counterexamples
